title: Wire the activity hook into the Claude hook manifests and repo settings
action: Per D1 declare the activity hook in BOTH renderers. (1) devtools/hook_manifests.rs CATALOG: add a CLAUDE_ONLY group ("bee-activity.mjs", "bee: activity") to the existing UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse (a matcher-less group so every tool counts), PostToolUse, Stop, and SessionEnd events, and add new Event rows for PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, and Notification each carrying only that group. Never add it to SubagentStop. Update the ALLOWED_DIFFERENCES comment block and the projections_differ_only_where_approved test so the Claude-only rows are the approved asymmetry; keep .codex/hooks.json byte-stable. (2) onboard/hooks_wiring.rs render_repo_hook_entries: add the same event/verb rows to the hard-coded list so .claude/settings.json carries them; extend the key-order test; keep the Codex event-key test unchanged. Then run `bee dev render-hook-manifests --write` and `bee onboard --repo-root . --apply` from the worktree and commit the regenerated packages/bee/hooks/claude-hooks.json, packages/bee/hooks/hooks.json and .claude/settings.json. Run `bee dev release-manifest --check`; if the manifest lists those hook files, run `bee dev regen` and commit its output in the same commit. Commit with trailer `cell: aah-2`.
